[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n and array a, then repeatedly searches the unseen right-to-left block for the current target t, marking matches as seen and collecting them in ans, narrowing the active unseen block; if a required target is absent it prints -1 and returns, otherwise it prints every element of ans on its own line." solve]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read an integer n from the fast input using ni(). RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Allocate an integer array a of length n. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For each index i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, read an integer using ni() and store it in a[i]. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Allocate a boolean array seen of length n, with all elements initialized to false. RESULT seen]
            [COMMAND Create an empty ArrayList<Integer> named ans. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Set t = 1, l = 0, and r = n - 1. RESULT t, l, r]
            [COMMAND Enter the outer while(true) loop; its only successful exit is the break taken when the gap-finding block leaves flag true, and failure exits are the two returns that print -1. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, start the main right-to-left for loop over i from n-1 down to 0 inclusive. The loop label 'outer' is present but no labeled break/continue targets it. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the main for loop, if seen[i] is true, execute continue to move to the next decremented i. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Within the main for loop, if i < l, take the failure alternative flow that prints -1 and returns; otherwise continue. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Within the main for loop, if a[i] is not equal to t, continue scanning left to the next decremented i. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Within the main for loop, when a[i] equals t, set seen[i] = true and append a[i] to ans. RESULT seen, ans]
            [COMMAND Within this matched case, initialize flag = true, then check all j from i+1 to n-1 inclusive; if any seen[j] is false, set flag = false. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND Within this matched case, if flag is true (every index to the right of i is already seen), break out of the main for loop only. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Within this matched case, if flag is false, increment t by 1, set i = n, and continue the main for loop. Because the for-loop update performs i--, the next iteration restarts the scan from i = n-1. RESULT t, i]
            [COMMAND After the main for loop exits, within the outer while loop, if seen[n-1] is false, take the failure alternative flow that prints -1 and returns; otherwise continue. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, set flag = true for the gap-finding block. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND Within the gap-finding block, scan i from n-1 down to 0 inclusive to find the rightmost index i for which seen[i] is false. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the gap-finding block, if no such unseen index is found (flag remains true), break out of the outer while(true) loop. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Within the gap-finding block, when an unseen index i is found, set t = a[i+1] (valid because seen[n-1] is true, so i is not n-1), set flag = false, set r = i, then scan j leftward from i with j decrementing; for each j, if seen[j] is true break the inner loop, otherwise set l = j. After the inner loop, break out of the gap-finding for loop. RESULT t, r, l, flag]
            [COMMAND Repeat the outer while loop using the updated t, l, and r. RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND After the outer while loop exits successfully, iterate over each element i in ans and print it on its own line using out.println(i). RESULT no_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: In the main right-to-left for loop, an unseen index i satisfies i < l.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print -1 to the standard output using out.println(-1). RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Return from solve() immediately. RESULT no_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Immediately after the main right-to-left for loop exits, seen[n-1] is still false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print -1 to the standard output using out.println(-1). RESULT no_result]
            [COMMAND Return from solve() immediately. RESULT no_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
